verdict: Zero leads this period; ad spend is live but the conversion layer is not.
narrative: In the last 28 days, your Meta ads delivered 251 clicks and spent $124.78 — and produced zero leads. The problem is not the audience; it is that the landing pages and conversion tracking were never fully launched, so clicks have nowhere to convert. Several foundational build steps that were due in late July and August remain unfinished, which is what is holding back results across paid, search, and local. Those items are being resolved in priority order this week, starting with the conversion layer. Once the tracking and landing pages are live, spend will have a functioning path to produce leads and you will see that reflected immediately in next period's numbers.
